orgs.estimated_depth: Unknown - no enumerable per-person pattern found
orgs.notes: Young Life operates through regional subdomains with centralized /donate/ and /staff/ pages at regional level (e.g., manateecounty.younglife.org/donate/). Also uses giving.younglife.org/s/ for national giving. While FAQs mention ability to designate gifts to 'the Young Life mission unit or person' by name, no evidence found of enumerable per-person URLs with consistent naming (like /donate/<name> or /staff/<name>). Giving appears centralized at regional subdomain level, not per individual staff member. Each regional chapter manages its own giving portal.

orgs.estimated_depth: Several hundred+ - staffId parameter suggests large numeric range (IDs in 50000s-70000s range observed)
orgs.notes: YFCI operates a dual pattern for individual staff support. Primary pattern: give.yfci.org/donate-now?staffId=<numeric_id> allows donors to give to specific staff by ID. Secondary pattern: epray.yfci.org/appeals/<person_name>/ provides prayer/donation appeals. Local chapter domains (yfcdenver.org, socalyfc.org) also have their own /give/ paths. The staffId parameter indicates clean enumeration potential; observed IDs include 52900, 73400 suggesting substantial depth.

orgs.estimated_depth: Likely 500+ - numeric IDs observed up to 7 digits (1158081) suggest substantial enumerable population
orgs.notes: Cru publishes individual staff member giving pages at give.cru.org/<numeric_id>. Each staff member has a dedicated numeric ID within the give.cru.org domain. Examples include: Leah Darwin (0119905), John and Kim Nicholson (0113279), Mike and Sus Schmitt (0124650), San Diego Circle Gabriella Quitevis (1158081), San Diego Circle Natalie Ceja (1099003). Cru's staff model requires each team member to 'raise their own support' - a key indicator that per-person pages are primary fundraising mechanism. The numeric ID pattern appears consistent and enumerable.
